seo.title: Delete Your Valam Account and Data | Valam
seo.description: Delete your Valam account and cloud data in the app in under a minute, remove data on your phone, or request deletion by email. See exactly what is erased and what is kept.

title: Delete your account
intro: You can delete your Valam account yourself, inside the app, in under a minute. This page explains how, what is erased, what is kept, and what to do if you cannot open the app.

options.title: Delete your account in the app
options.audience: Recommended. For anyone who signed in
options.body: A Valam account exists only if you signed in for Plus, sync, shared groups or the free month. Deleting it erases what the server holds for you straight away, apart from the few records listed under What stays.
steps: Open Valam and go to Settings.
Under Account, tap Delete account. If you are on the Valam Plus screen, you will find the same button at the bottom.
Read the summary, then tap Delete account to confirm.
If you signed in a while ago, Valam asks you to sign in again to prove it is you, then finishes the deletion.
You will see a message that your account was deleted. Syncing stops and you are signed out.

options.title: Cancel your subscription
options.audience: If you subscribed to Valam Plus
options.body: Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription, because purchases are managed by Apple or Google. Cancel it so you are not billed again.
steps: On iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions, choose Valam and tap Cancel Subscription.
On Android, open Google Play, tap your profile picture, then Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions, choose Valam and tap Cancel subscription.

options.title: Delete the data on your phone
options.body: Your ledger, attachments and chat history with Mathi live only on your phone. Deleting your account leaves them in place, so you can keep using Valam without an account. To erase them as well:
steps: Export a backup first if you may want your data later (Settings, then Backup).
On iPhone, press and hold the Valam icon, choose Remove App, then Delete App. On Android, press and hold the icon and choose Uninstall.
Delete any backup files (.fbak) you saved to Files, iCloud Drive or Google Drive, and any sync folder Valam created in your own iCloud or Google Drive.

options.title: Cannot open the app? Ask us to delete it
options.body: If you no longer have the app or your phone, send us a request and we will delete the account for you after checking it is yours.
steps: Fill in the form below or email privacy@valam.io from the email address linked to your account. If you signed in with a phone number, Apple or Google, say which one.
We will reply to verify that the request comes from you.
Within 30 days we will delete your account and the data listed below, and confirm by email.

deleted.title: What is erased
items: Your sign in account (email, phone number, Apple or Google sign in)
Your encrypted sync copy and the key check that goes with it
Your list of shared groups, your invitation inbox and your group identity backup and name
Your Mathi credit balance and its history
Your Plus entitlement record on our server
Any entry that lets friends find you by email or phone
Invite codes you made or used, and invitations you sent that have not been opened

kept.title: What stays
items: Your data on your phone, until you delete it yourself
Shared group history. You leave every group, but the encrypted entries you added stay with the other members, because their balances depend on them
A one-way fingerprint (hash) of your email or phone number, so the free month can't be claimed twice
Your account id as a former member of each shared group you were in
Purchase records held by Apple and Google under their own policies, and by RevenueCat, our subscription provider, linked to your account id
Limited records we must keep for a time where the law requires it

warning: Deleting an account is permanent and cannot be undone. Valam cannot restore it. Your data on your phone is not touched, so export a backup if you want a copy.

form.title: Request deletion by email
form.reasonPlaceholder: Tell us why you are leaving, if you like
form.confirmLabel: I understand that this is permanent
form.help: This opens your email app with a pre filled message to our privacy team. We reply to verify your identity before deleting anything.
